sections.installation:
Download & Upload:

  1. Download the Mobile Start Button plugin (.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New.
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the mobile-start-button.zip file, click on Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
